question: 2014 年佣金收入低于 50 万的分支，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT db.Branch AS branch, SUM(ft.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON ft.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2014 GROUP BY db.Branch HAVING SUM(ft.Commission) < 500000 ORDER BY commission_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 度量阈值下界载体（HAVING 语义，< 方向）
营业部/分支是组织的子单元（OMG Commons）
